subject: Distributed and Cloud Computing
chapters: Cloud Computing Architecture, IaaS, PaaS, SaaS & Virtualization
Distributed File Systems & Big Data Processing (Hadoop, MapReduce)

questions.text: Define a Distributed System. Explain its key characteristics: Heterogeneity, Openness, Scalability, Fault Tolerance, Transparency (Access, Location, Migration, Relocation, Replication, Concurrency, Failure).

Explain the concept of Logical Clocks and Lamport's Happens-Before Relation ($a \to b$). What are the conditions for Lamport's Logical Clock? Explain Vector Clocks and how they capture causal relationships between events in distributed systems.

Explain Distributed Mutual Exclusion algorithms: (a) Centralized Algorithm, (b) Distributed Algorithm (Ricart-Agrawala algorithm using timestamps), and (c) Token Ring Algorithm. Compare their message complexities, synchronization delays, and single points of failure.

State the CAP Theorem (Consistency, Availability, Partition Tolerance) and PACELC Theorem for distributed data stores. Explain Consensus in asynchronous distributed systems and the Raft / Paxos consensus algorithm.

questions.chapter: Cloud Computing Architecture, IaaS, PaaS, SaaS & Virtualization
questions.text: Explain Cloud Computing Service Models: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Software as a Service (SaaS). Compare Public, Private, Hybrid, and Community Cloud deployment models.

questions.chapter: Cloud Computing Architecture, IaaS, PaaS, SaaS & Virtualization
questions.text: Explain Virtualization in Cloud Computing. Compare Type-1 (Bare-Metal) Hypervisor vs. Type-2 (Hosted) Hypervisor. Explain Full Virtualization, Para-Virtualization, and Operating System-Level Virtualization (Containers vs VMs / Docker & Kubernetes).

questions.chapter: Distributed File Systems & Big Data Processing (Hadoop, MapReduce)
questions.text: Explain the architecture of Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS): NameNode, DataNodes, Secondary NameNode, Block Replication, Heartbeats, and Block Reports. How does HDFS ensure fault tolerance?

questions.chapter: Distributed File Systems & Big Data Processing (Hadoop, MapReduce)
questions.text: Explain the MapReduce Distributed Computing Paradigm (Map phase, Shuffle & Sort, Reduce phase). Write the pseudo-code for Word Count problem in MapReduce and trace the execution for a given text dataset across 3 nodes.

Explain Service Level Agreements (SLA) in Cloud Computing. Explain Cloud Security challenges (Multi-tenancy isolation, Data encryption at rest and in transit, Identity and Access Management - IAM). Compare Monolithic Architecture vs. Microservices Architecture with API Gateways and Service Mesh.
Explain Election Algorithms in distributed systems: (a) Bully Algorithm, and (b) Ring Algorithm. Show the sequence of messages passed when the current coordinator process crashes.
